a2n=(2n−1)2−2(2n−2)2+⋯−n3+⋯−(2n−2)22+(2n−1)=(2n−1)2−2(2n−2)2+⋯+(n−1)(n+1)2−n3 +(2n−1)−(2n−2)22+⋯+(n+1)(n−1)2=(2n−1)(2n)−2(2n−2)(2n)+⋯+(n−1)(n+1)(2n)−n3={(2n−1)−2(2n−2)+⋯+(n−1)(n+1)}(2n)−n3={(n2−(n−1)2)−(n2−(n−2)2)+⋯+(n2−12)}(2n)−n3={(n2−n2+⋯+n2−n2+n2)−(n−1)2+(n−2)2−⋯+22−12}(2n)−n3={n2−(n−1)2+(n−2)2−⋯+22−12}(2n)−n3={−12+22−32+42+⋯−(n−1)2+n2}(2n)−n3\begin{aligned} a_{2n} &= (2n-1)^2 - 2(2n-2)^2 + \cdots - n^3 + \cdots - (2n-2)2^2 + (2n-1) \\ &= (2n-1)^2 - 2(2n-2)^2 + \cdots + (n-1)(n+1)^2 - n^3 \\ &\quad\ + (2n-1) - (2n-2)2^2 + \cdots + (n+1)(n-1)^2 \\ &= (2n-1)(2n) - 2(2n-2)(2n) + \cdots + (n-1)(n+1)(2n) - n^3 \\ &= \{(2n-1) - 2(2n-2) + \cdots + (n-1)(n+1)\}(2n) - n^3 \\ &= \left\{\left(n^2 - (n-1)^2\right) - \left(n^2 - (n-2)^2\right) + \cdots + \left(n^2 - 1^2\right)\right\}(2n) - n^3 \\ &= \left\{\left(n^2 - n^2 + \cdots + n^2 - n^2 + n^2\right) - (n-1)^2 + (n-2)^2 - \cdots + 2^2 - 1^2\right\}(2n) - n^3 \\ &= \left\{n^2 - (n-1)^2 + (n-2)^2 - \cdots + 2^2 - 1^2\right\}(2n) - n^3 \\ &= \left\{-1^2 + 2^2 - 3^2 + 4^2 + \cdots - (n-1)^2 + n^2\right\}(2n) - n^3 \end{aligned}a2n​​=(2n−1)2−2(2n−2)2+⋯−n3+⋯−(2n−2)22+(2n−1)=(2n−1)2−2(2n−2)2+⋯+(n−1)(n+1)2−n3 +(2n−1)−(2n−2)22+⋯+(n+1)(n−1)2=(2n−1)(2n)−2(2n−2)(2n)+⋯+(n−1)(n+1)(2n)−n3={(2n−1)−2(2n−2)+⋯+(n−1)(n+1)}(2n)−n3={(n2−(n−1)2)−(n2−(n−2)2)+⋯+(n2−12)}(2n)−n3={(n2−n2+⋯+n2−n2+n2)−(n−1)2+(n−2)2−⋯+22−12}(2n)−n3={n2−(n−1)2+(n−2)2−⋯+22−12}(2n)−n3={−12+22−32+42+⋯−(n−1)2+n2}(2n)−n3​

={(−1+2)(1+2)+(−3+4)(3+4)+⋯+(−n+1+n)(n−1+n)}(2n)−n3={1+2+3+4+⋯+(n−1)+n}(2n)−n3=n(n+1)(2n)2−n3=n2\begin{aligned} &= \{(-1+2)(1+2) + (-3+4)(3+4) + \cdots + (-n+1+n)(n-1+n)\}(2n) - n^3 \\ &= \{1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + \cdots + (n-1) + n\}(2n) - n^3 = \frac{n(n+1)(2n)}{2} - n^3 = n^2 \end{aligned}​={(−1+2)(1+2)+(−3+4)(3+4)+⋯+(−n+1+n)(n−1+n)}(2n)−n3={1+2+3+4+⋯+(n−1)+n}(2n)−n3=2n(n+1)(2n)​−n3=n2​

같은 방법으로, 자연수 nnn이 홀수일 때

a2n=(2n−1)2−2(2n−2)2+⋯+n3−⋯−(2n−2)22+(2n−1)={(n2−n2+⋯+n2−n2)−(n−1)2+(n−2)2−⋯−22+12}(2n)+n3=−[1+2+3+4+⋯+n−1](2n)+n3=−(n−1)(n)(2n)2+n3=n2\begin{aligned} a_{2n} &= (2n-1)^2 - 2(2n-2)^2 + \cdots + n^3 - \cdots - (2n-2)2^2 + (2n-1) \\ &= \left\{\left(n^2 - n^2 + \cdots + n^2 - n^2\right) - (n-1)^2 + (n-2)^2 - \cdots - 2^2 + 1^2\right\}(2n) + n^3 \\ &= -[1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + \cdots + n - 1](2n) + n^3 = -\frac{(n-1)(n)(2n)}{2} + n^3 = n^2 \end{aligned}a2n​​=(2n−1)2−2(2n−2)2+⋯+n3−⋯−(2n−2)22+(2n−1)={(n2−n2+⋯+n2−n2)−(n−1)2+(n−2)2−⋯−22+12}(2n)+n3=−[1+2+3+4+⋯+n−1](2n)+n3=−2(n−1)(n)(2n)​+n3=n2​

따라서 임의의 자연수 nnn에 대하여 a2n=n2a_{2n} = n^2a2n​=n2이다.

a2n+1=−(2n)2+2(2n−1)2−3(2n−2)2+⋯−(2n−1)22+(2n)=−(2n)2+(2n−1)2−2(2n−2)2+⋯−(2n−2)22+(2n−1)+(2n−1)2−(2n−2)2+⋯−22+1=−(2n)2+a2n+(2n−1)2−(2n−2)2+⋯−22+12=a2n+{−(2n)2+(2n−1)2−(2n−2)2+(2n−3)2−⋯−22+12}=a2n+{(−2n+(2n−1))(2n+(2n−1))+⋯+(−2+1)(2+1)}=n2−{2n+(2n−1)+⋯+2+1}=n2−2n(2n+1)2=−n(n+1)\begin{aligned} a_{2n+1} &= -(2n)^2 + 2(2n-1)^2 - 3(2n-2)^2 + \cdots - (2n-1)2^2 + (2n) \\ &= -(2n)^2 + (2n-1)^2 - 2(2n-2)^2 + \cdots - (2n-2)2^2 + (2n-1) \\ &\qquad\qquad + (2n-1)^2 - (2n-2)^2 + \cdots - 2^2 + 1 \\ &= -(2n)^2 + a_{2n} + (2n-1)^2 - (2n-2)^2 + \cdots - 2^2 + 1^2 \\ &= a_{2n} + \left\{-(2n)^2 + (2n-1)^2 - (2n-2)^2 + (2n-3)^2 - \cdots - 2^2 + 1^2\right\} \\ &= a_{2n} + \{(-2n + (2n-1))(2n + (2n-1)) + \cdots + (-2+1)(2+1)\} \\ &= n^2 - \{2n + (2n-1) + \cdots + 2 + 1\} = n^2 - \frac{2n(2n+1)}{2} = -n(n+1) \end{aligned}a2n+1​​=−(2n)2+2(2n−1)2−3(2n−2)2+⋯−(2n−1)22+(2n)=−(2n)2+(2n−1)2−2(2n−2)2+⋯−(2n−2)22+(2n−1)+(2n−1)2−(2n−2)2+⋯−22+1=−(2n)2+a2n​+(2n−1)2−(2n−2)2+⋯−22+12=a2n​+{−(2n)2+(2n−1)2−(2n−2)2+(2n−3)2−⋯−22+12}=a2n​+{(−2n+(2n−1))(2n+(2n−1))+⋯+(−2+1)(2+1)}=n2−{2n+(2n−1)+⋯+2+1}=n2−22n(2n+1)​=−n(n+1)​

결국, 자연수 nnn에 대하여 a2n=n2a_{2n} = n^2a2n​=n2, a2n+1=−n(n+1)a_{2n+1} = -n(n+1)a2n+1​=−n(n+1)이다.

∑k=12nak=∑k=1na2k−1+∑k=1na2k=∑k=1n(−k2+k)+∑k=1nk2=∑k=1nk=n(n+1)2 (>0),\sum_{k=1}^{2n} a_k = \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{2k-1} + \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{2k} = \sum_{k=1}^{n} \left(-k^2 + k\right) + \sum_{k=1}^{n} k^2 = \sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}\ (> 0),k=1∑2n​ak​=k=1∑n​a2k−1​+k=1∑n​a2k​=k=1∑n​(−k2+k)+k=1∑n​k2=k=1∑n​k=2n(n+1)​ (>0),

∑k=12n−1ak=(∑k=1na2k−1)+(∑k=1na2k)−a2n=∑k=1n(−k2+k)+∑k=1nk2−n2=∑k=1nk−n2=12n(n+1)−n2=n2(1−n) (<0)\begin{aligned} \sum_{k=1}^{2n-1} a_k &= \left(\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{2k-1}\right) + \left(\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{2k}\right) - a_{2n} = \sum_{k=1}^{n} \left(-k^2 + k\right) + \sum_{k=1}^{n} k^2 - n^2 \\ &= \sum_{k=1}^{n} k - n^2 = \frac{1}{2}n(n+1) - n^2 = \frac{n}{2}(1-n)\ (< 0) \end{aligned}k=1∑2n−1​ak​​=(k=1∑n​a2k−1​)+(k=1∑n​a2k​)−a2n​=k=1∑n​(−k2+k)+k=1∑n​k2−n2=k=1∑n​k−n2=21​n(n+1)−n2=2n​(1−n) (<0)​

이고, 주어진 조건이 ∑k=1mak=−78 (<0)\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{m} a_k = -78\ (< 0)k=1∑m​ak​=−78 (<0)이므로 mmm은 홀수이고 m=25m = 25m=25이다.

g(x)=∣t−f(x)∣g(x) = |t - f(x)|g(x)=∣t−f(x)∣이므로 미분가능하지 않은 실수 xxx의 값은 직선 y=ty = ty=t와 y=f(x)y = f(x)y=f(x)가 만나는 점의 xxx좌표 중에 존재한다. f′(x)=−x3+(3−a)x2+(2a−b)x+bexf'(x) = \dfrac{-x^3 + (3-a)x^2 + (2a-b)x + b}{e^x}f′(x)=ex−x3+(3−a)x2+(2a−b)x+b​이고 ex>0e^x > 0ex>0이므로 f′(x)=0f'(x) = 0f′(x)=0의 근은 −x3+(3−a)x2+(2a−b)x+b=0-x^3 + (3-a)x^2 + (2a-b)x + b = 0−x3+(3−a)x2+(2a−b)x+b=0의 근과 같고, lim⁡x→∞f(x)=0\displaystyle\lim_{x\to\infty} f(x) = 0x→∞lim​f(x)=0이므로 xxx축이 점근선이다.

조건 (가)에서 불연속인 실수의 값은 2개이므로 y=f(x)y = f(x)y=f(x)의 그래프 개형은 다음과 같이 생각할 수 있다.

(1) f′(x)=0f'(x) = 0f′(x)=0의 서로 다른 실근이 3개인 경우, 조건 (가)를 만족하려면 두 개의 극댓값이 같고 극솟값이 000이어야 한다.
따라서 lim⁡t→0+h(t)+lim⁡t→0−h(t)+h(0)=4+1+1=6\displaystyle\lim_{t\to 0+} h(t) + \lim_{t\to 0-} h(t) + h(0) = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6t→0+lim​h(t)+t→0−lim​h(t)+h(0)=4+1+1=6이므로 조건 (나)를 만족시키지 않는다.

(2) f′(x)=0f'(x) = 0f′(x)=0의 서로 다른 실근이 2개인 경우, 조건 (가)를 만족하려면 f′(x)f'(x)f′(x)는 x=0x = 0x=0에서 중근을 가져야 한다. 따라서 lim⁡t→0+h(t)+lim⁡t→0−h(t)+h(0)=2+1+0=3\displaystyle\lim_{t\to 0+} h(t) + \lim_{t\to 0-} h(t) + h(0) = 2 + 1 + 0 = 3t→0+lim​h(t)+t→0−lim​h(t)+h(0)=2+1+0=3이므로 조건 (나)를 만족시킨다.

(3) f′(x)=0f'(x) = 0f′(x)=0의 서로 다른 실근이 1개인 경우, 극댓값만 존재한다.
lim⁡t→0+h(t)+lim⁡t→0−h(t)+h(0)=2+1+1=4\displaystyle\lim_{t\to 0+} h(t) + \lim_{t\to 0-} h(t) + h(0) = 2 + 1 + 1 = 4t→0+lim​h(t)+t→0−lim​h(t)+h(0)=2+1+1=4이므로 조건 (나)를 만족시키지 않는다.

따라서 −x3+(3−a)x2+(2a−b)x+b=0-x^3 + (3-a)x^2 + (2a-b)x + b = 0−x3+(3−a)x2+(2a−b)x+b=0은 x=0x = 0x=0에서 중근을 가져야 하므로 a=b=0a = b = 0a=b=0이고 f(x)=x3exf(x) = \dfrac{x^3}{e^x}f(x)=exx3​이다. 변곡점을 구하면 f′′(x)=x3−6x2+6xexf''(x) = \dfrac{x^3 - 6x^2 + 6x}{e^x}f′′(x)=exx3−6x2+6x​이므로 x2−6x+6=0x^2 - 6x + 6 = 0x2−6x+6=0의 두 근이 000이 아닌 두 변곡점의 xxx좌표이다. 두 변곡점의 xxx좌표를 각각 α,β\alpha, \betaα,β라 하면 α+β=6, αβ=6\alpha + \beta = 6,\ \alpha\beta = 6α+β=6, αβ=6이다.

따라서 f′(α)f′(β)=α2(3−α)eα β2(3−β)eβ=α2β2(9−3α−3β+αβ)eα+β=−108e6f'(\alpha)f'(\beta) = \dfrac{\alpha^2(3-\alpha)}{e^\alpha}\,\dfrac{\beta^2(3-\beta)}{e^\beta} = \dfrac{\alpha^2\beta^2(9 - 3\alpha - 3\beta + \alpha\beta)}{e^{\alpha+\beta}} = -\dfrac{108}{e^6}f′(α)f′(β)=eαα2(3−α)​eββ2(3−β)​=eα+βα2β2(9−3α−3β+αβ)​=−e6108​이다.

b8=(b7)2=(b6)4=(b5)8=⋯=(b1)128b_8 = (b_7)^2 = (b_6)^4 = (b_5)^8 = \cdots = (b_1)^{128}b8​=(b7​)2=(b6​)4=(b5​)8=⋯=(b1​)128

dn+1=cn+1−2cn+1+2=cn+2cn+1−2cn+2cn+1+2=cn+2−2 cn−2cn+2+2 cn+2=(1−2)(cn−2)(1+2)(cn+2)=d1dn\begin{aligned} d_{n+1} &= \frac{c_{n+1} - \sqrt{2}}{c_{n+1} + \sqrt{2}} = \frac{\dfrac{c_n + 2}{c_n + 1} - \sqrt{2}}{\dfrac{c_n + 2}{c_n + 1} + \sqrt{2}} = \frac{c_n + 2 - \sqrt{2}\,c_n - \sqrt{2}}{c_n + 2 + \sqrt{2}\,c_n + \sqrt{2}} \\ &= \frac{(1 - \sqrt{2})(c_n - \sqrt{2})}{(1 + \sqrt{2})(c_n + \sqrt{2})} = d_1 d_n \end{aligned}dn+1​​=cn+1​+2​cn+1​−2​​=cn​+1cn​+2​+2​cn​+1cn​+2​−2​​=cn​+2+2​cn​+2​cn​+2−2​cn​−2​​=(1+2​)(cn​+2​)(1−2​)(cn​−2​)​=d1​dn​​

이다. 즉, 모든 자연수 nnn에 대하여 dn+1=d1dnd_{n+1} = d_1 d_ndn+1​=d1​dn​이다. 따라서

d8=d1d7=d12d6=d13d5=⋯=d17d1=d18d_8 = d_1 d_7 = d_1^2 d_6 = d_1^3 d_5 = \cdots = d_1^7 d_1 = d_1^8d8​=d1​d7​=d12​d6​=d13​d5​=⋯=d17​d1​=d18​

이므로 q=8q = 8q=8.

또한, d27=(d1)27=b8=a8−2a8+2=1+−22a8+2d_{2^7} = (d_1)^{2^7} = b_8 = \dfrac{a_8 - \sqrt{2}}{a_8 + \sqrt{2}} = 1 + \dfrac{-2\sqrt{2}}{a_8 + \sqrt{2}}d27​=(d1​)27=b8​=a8​+2​a8​−2​​=1+a8​+2​−22​​이고,

d27=c27−2c27+2=1+−22c27+2d_{2^7} = \dfrac{c_{2^7} - \sqrt{2}}{c_{2^7} + \sqrt{2}} = 1 + \dfrac{-2\sqrt{2}}{c_{2^7} + \sqrt{2}}d27​=c27​+2​c27​−2​​=1+c27​+2​−22​​이므로 a8=c27a_8 = c_{2^7}a8​=c27​.

따라서 a8=c128a_8 = c_{128}a8​=c128​이므로 m=128m = 128m=128.
